Use case: identity-preserve. Render ONE new full-body transparent game sprite: W hit frame 03 of 06. Image 1 is the character's preceding W02 hit frame, exact identity, left-side camera, costume, fox/crystal hands, proportions and ground placement. Image 2 is approved STYLE only: bright, clean, rounded Chinese Daoist chibi hand painting, detailed soft fur and cloth. Keep image 1's girl rather than any person or UI in image 2.
Preserve silver short bob, purple eye, furry ears, left-temple snowflake ornament, white-lilac fur-trimmed robe, purple belt and silver fox-face buckle, blue charms and boots. The near anatomical LEFT arm cradles exactly one white fox at her left ribs; the far anatomical RIGHT hand carries one small snowflake crystal toward screen LEFT. No swapping hands. Strict single-eye LEFT side profile; head, chest, pelvis and both boots point LEFT.
Frame W03 of 06, maximum recoil: impact from screen LEFT pushes shoulders 38 pixels toward screen RIGHT. Chest and head lean back 12 degrees while hips stay over the planted boots; both knees flex 18 degrees. One visible eye squeezes shut, small flinch mouth. LEFT arm hugs fox securely against ribs; RIGHT elbow folds to retract crystal 38 pixels toward chest and 12 pixels upward from idle, clearly supported by the same palm. Robe and tassels lag toward screen LEFT. Strict side profile, not front three-quarter.
Same fixed full-canvas camera as image 1: native square at least 1024, normalized ground y942 and torso-root x520. No individual auto-centering or auto-scaling. Entire subject with clean margins. Genuine transparent RGBA, clean natural edges without saturated blue/magenta key fringe. No girl's tail, extra limbs, floor, shadow, UI, text, background, grid, particles, burst or beam. Independently draw this different reaction phase, do not mirror, warp, copy or interpolate.
